svg.text: What ws-host writes, and what it leaves alone
Three managed files, each by consent
A marked prompt block in ~/.bashrc, after shell add bash
A marked prompt block in fish config.fish, after shell add fish
Missing keys in the VS Code settings file, never a key you set
Never read: any chezmoi config or source of your own, and any text outside the markers
Only text between the markers, or a key that was absent, is ever written
